ticket_id: CW-18 review corrections R1, R2, R3, R5, R6
required_behavior: R1 (P1): the worker becomes free as soon as the done/blocked report (work) or the experiment report is DELIVERED to the manager OMP (accepted into its session), not after the manager finishes its turn; a to_worker issued by the manager in the very turn that reads the report must be accepted; no fixed 20 s window can leave a Task busy/held forever - if the delivery outcome is unknown, release the worker with the Task closed as report_outcome_unknown (no resend) and tell the manager in the next tool result notices.

R2: cancel withdraws every not-yet-created/undelivered (DEFERRED or queued) message of the cancelled Task from the outbox before anything else is sent; the worker never receives a cancelled TASK after its cancel; a to_manager without task_id is attributed to the active Task only, never to a Task created after the report was queued.
R3: a done/blocked report that was queued but never created/delivered while paused is delivered after resume (this is not a replay); Tasks never stay busy because of a dropped report.

R5: do not hold the user's host input while the TASK is being delivered or the worker is deciding; hold only from the moment Workbench types until the run is handed back (keep the idle-only start rules).
R6: a fast cancel unbinds automation from the closed run (state returns to idle).
acceptance: red->green tests reproducing each finding (the reviewer's repro scenarios), incl. 'to_worker in the same turn as the report is accepted' and 'long manager turn does not leave the Task busy'

all suites with real exit codes (no pipes): tests/backend, tests/bridge, tests/workflow, tests/lifecycle, tests/terminal, tests/contracts, tests/ui, gates g1_vt/g2_shell, TS bridge tests; live WB_LIVE_CW18=1 once
rules: No model prompts (scripted provider only); OMP only with the Workbench home or a fake HOME (never the real HOME); never read credential contents or other processes' environ; temp dirs only under /tmp; robust teardown; kill only PIDs you started; never touch ~/wb-urux-sandbox or the user's processes or configs; no commits, no graphify update. A parallel worker edits omp_bridge/skills and src/workbench/ui/product - do not touch them.
result_format: checks table first, status, fix summary per finding, changed paths + sha256, residue. Korean, <=20 lines.
